app_subtitle: Interactive map of specially protected natural areas
about_text1: Welcome to a digital journey through the most picturesque, mysterious and protected corners of the Bobruisk region!
about_text2: This project is designed to rediscover the unique wealth of our native land: from ancient centuries-old oaks and glacial lakes to untouched sphagnum bogs and unique landscapes.
about_feature1: Explore: Find rare protected areas on the map.
about_feature2: Get inspired: View unique photos and videos.
about_feature3: Learn: Discover the history and ecological value of each site.
about_footer: Let's preserve the natural heritage of Bobruisk region together!
about_author_description: The website was written with the help of AI DeepSeek on HTML, CSS and JavaScript in 2 days (about 12 hours of continuous work). Nothing complicated overall. The project was created to promote the unique nature of the Bobruisk region.
about_details_text: The site is built with HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript (ES6+). The interactive map uses the Leaflet library, and the interface is adapted for desktop and mobile devices. Local images and SVG icons are part of the project, while object data is stored in language-specific JSON files.
hero_subtitle: Interactive atlas of the natural corners of the Bobruisk region
hero_lead: Explore protected landscapes, ancient trees, lakes and wetland complexes — in one digital journey.
intro_title: The nature of Bobruisk — closer than it seems.
intro_text: Discover places that are easy to pass by: ancient trees, rare bogs, lake cascades and protected landscapes.
intro_title_html:
The nature of Bobruisk —
closer than it seems.
about_page_text1: Welcome to a digital journey through the natural places of the Bobruisk area. The project brings together protected landscapes, natural monuments and hydrological reserves on an interactive map.
about_page_text2: The project combines a map, an object catalogue, photographs and video materials to make the natural heritage of the Bobruisk area easy to explore.
about_page_feature1: Explore — find places and move between the catalogue and the map.
about_page_feature2: Watch — view photographs and available video materials.
about_page_feature3: Learn — read the history and information from the source materials.
about_page_footer: Let’s preserve the natural heritage of the Bobruisk area together!
catalog_subtitle: Explore protected areas, natural monuments and natural complexes of the Bobruisk region.
